name: rinx
description: Live preview and diagnostics for Rinx documentation

rinx.binaryPath.description: Path to the rinx binary, used by the preview and the language server. Can be a bare command (if in PATH) or an absolute path (e.g., /usr/local/bin/rinx). When unset, the binary is discovered through Bazel, then the one bundled into the extension (if any), falling back to `rinx` on the PATH.

rinx.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the rinx language server in the Rinx output channel.

enumDescriptions: Ask once per workspace, naming the sites, before downloading.
Never download; references into another site stay hints.
rinx.inventories.download.description: Whether the language server may download the `objects.inv` of the sites a Sphinx project's `intersphinx_mapping` links into, so references into them resolve. Downloads are cached for the project's `intersphinx_cache_limit` days.

rinx.conf.execute.description: Whether the language server may run a Sphinx project's `conf.py` in a trusted workspace, for the exact values of the settings it computes rather than spells as literals. Off, `conf.py` is read without running it, and what cannot be read is underlined there.

rinx.conf.pythonPath.description: The Python interpreter `conf.py` runs in when `rinx.conf.execute` is on: a command on the PATH, or a path, relative to the workspace folder. When empty, the interpreter selected with the Python extension is used, if it is installed.

rinx.autoDiscover.description: Whether the extension runs Bazel: to find the `rinx` binary a Bazel workspace builds, and to build its sites' manifests for the language server. Requires `bazel` to be on the PATH.

rinx.site.description: The `rinx_site` this workspace is about, such as `//docs:site`: a document several sites list belongs to it in the language server, and is previewed as part of it. When empty, the first site by label.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.package:check: npm run -s package:files | LC_ALL=C sort | diff vsix-files.txt -
